'''Soll's Pay-Later-Lot''' was a historic parking lot in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]'s [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. It was saved from being demolished and replaced by an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] arboretum by a successful campaign from the [[Parking Conservation Fund]], who have worked tirelessly to preserve and recognize [[Heritage Lots]] on the city-wide planet.<ref name="HNN 54" />
